annotations.title: Run the Video Studio auto-edit pass, or decide a suggestion

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Long-form Video Studio project `id`: with no `action` it runs the brand's enabled auto steps (dead-air trims at sentence boundaries, retake picks, dissolves, room tone, loudness, presets) and writes suggestion items for the timeline. Suggestions only: the master is never touched and nothing renders. Then `action` accept / remove / swap with a `suggestionId` (from video_studio_auto_suggestions) decides one: accept writes the board decision (undoable), swap picks another `transitionId`/`ms` or `presetId`. Free.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/projects/{id}/auto.)

ms.description: Swap a dissolve length; clamped to 400-700.

presetId.description: Swap a background preset or motion pack (effect catalog id).

transitionId.description: Swap a transition: cut or crossfade.
